usb_boot_gate_profile.truth: CHIP_EN = ESP_RESET_RC AND POWER_PERMIT with In1=GND
usb_boot_gate_profile.normal_selector: JP1 copper bridge1-2; USB_HIGH_CURRENT drives POWER_PERMIT
usb_boot_gate_profile.service_selector: Cut1-2 completely before solder bridge2-3; never bridgeboth
usb_boot_gate_profile.future_battery: Charger, battery connector and NTC footprint retained. NORMAL requires USB permission. SERVICE permits experimental battery boot but does not qualify cell protection, charging, PN532 supply/radio behavior or transient power.
usb_boot_gate_profile.cold_delay_scope: Empty C9 and valid3V logic step only; retained C9 charge after brief detach may allow immediate release once permission returns.
usb_boot_gate_profile.BQ_mode_settling: No guaranteed BQ EN2 transition bound established; full startup transient model has not completed.
usb_boot_gate_profile.PN532_prepermission_reset: Original R19 100k pulldown to GND retained. GPIO7 releases PN532 from power-down only after USB qualification. Complete pre-permission startup/current and arbitrary rail ramp behavior remain unqualified.

gate_circuit_reference.scope: Circuit and exact two new footprint libraries only; PN532 original board/routing retained and freshly rerouted.
